## Situation
Describe the situation leading to this **collector ticket**. When using bullet
points, put yourself 12 months from now and include enough context.

## Objective
Resolve the bullet points and/or split them into separate tickets.

## Additional Considerations
List constraints of the solution or detailed aspects of the objective (scope/not scope;
impact on existing code/features; non-functional expectations). Typically, this list is
adopted and expanded during refinement.
